scientific.integrity: Necessity is proved from the published anticanonical volume identity, one sharp elementary inequality, and an exhaustive divisibility argument on a rigorously bounded integer interval. Sufficiency uses the known smoothing of \(\mathbf P(1,1,2,4)\) and the trivial case \(\mathbf P^3\). No finite search or experimental inference is used.
limitations: The classification is restricted to the two-unit-weight family \(\mathbf P(1,1,a,b)\).
No sufficiency of the anticanonical volume equation is claimed outside this family.

A highly relevant 2026 preprint on weighted-projective degenerations was not directly available in full text during this check; the initiating paper describes it as a deformation-gluing framework rather than a numerical classification.

title: Two unit weights force the complete smoothing classification
